newsitem.title: USA: Wash. Grand Coulee 600 MW turbine seen online Wed..
newsitem.headline: Wash. Grand Coulee 600 MW turbine seen online Wed..

text.p: A 600 megawatt (MW) power turbine at the Grand Coulee dam in Washington state is set to restart late Wednesday, but overall power generation from the project may not change, industry sources said Tuesday.
An official at Grand Coulee said the unit, which has been down since February for maintenance, was expected to be back on line several days earlier than originally scheduled.
The project's total generating capacity is listed at 6,150 MW, but some turbines are off line from time to time for maintenance.

In addition, flows from Grand Coulee are being curtailed amid efforts to raise reservoir storage to 1,290 feet above sea level, compared with a level of 1,288 feet as of midday Tuesday, a BPA trader said earlier Tuesday.
He said the cutbacks are likely to continue at least through Friday.
Officials at Grand Coulee said authority over how much and when water is released from the dam lies with BPA.
